settings.text:
The Sound & Seed Retreat: Profound Healing, Clarity, and Growth

There are moments in life when we feel called to something greater—to step away from the familiar, quiet the noise, and truly listen. Beyond Boundaries is an invitation to embark on a journey of deep personal transformation in the spiritual heart of South India. Here, the wisdom of ancient India meets the curiosity of modern science, creating a rare opportunity to step into deep, embodied healing. This immersive retreat blends the timeless wisdom of Ayurveda, Siddha teachings, and sound healing, with modern neuroscience to help you release limiting patterns, restore inner harmony, and connect with your highest potential.

Guided by Dr. Kulreet Chaudhary and Joshua Barr, this retreat is not just about stepping into India—it’s about stepping into yourself in a way you never have before. Through sacred temple experiences, personalized healing sessions, and ancient practices tailored for modern life, you’ll experience tools that spark renewal from the inside out and leave with a renewed sense of clarity, resilience, and peace.

This journey isn’t about escape but rather about remembrance. You’ll reconnect to the healing power that already lives within you, waiting to be reawakened.

What You’ll Gain from This Transformative Experience in Tamil Nadu, India

Many of us spend our lives pushing through stress, old habits, and patterns that no longer serve us. Our nervous systems become overloaded, our clarity clouded, our energy scattered. Here, in the sacred landscapes of South India, you will have the space, support, and guidance to:

Rewire Your Mind & Body for Lasting Change – Through meditation, breathwork, yoga and sound healing, you will learn how to shift deep-rooted patterns and create new possibilities.

Heal & Recharge in a Sacred Setting – Immerse yourself in the ancient healing traditions of Ayurveda and Siddha healing, restoring balance and vitality in the very land of their origin..

Break Free from Mental Overload – Step into a simpler, quieter rhythm and reconnect with what truly matters.

Immerse Yourself in the Energy of Sacred Temples – Participate in powerful temple rituals, aligning with centuries-old traditions of healing and renewal.

Leave with Tools for Everyday Transformation – Learn practical methods to integrate clarity, resilience, and balance into your daily life.

settings.title: Sri Puram Golden Temple: A Mystical Haven of Divine Energy
settings.dropdown_text:
Hidden in the lush green landscapes of Vellore, Tamil Nadu, the Sri Puram Golden Temple is more than just an architectural marvel—it's a gateway to divine transformation. Shimmering with over 1.5 tons of pure gold, this sacred sanctuary radiates an otherworldly glow, reflecting the wisdom of the ancient Siddhas and the timeless power of devotion.

As you step onto the star-shaped pathway leading to the temple, each footstep becomes a meditative journey, aligning body, mind, and spirit with the temple’s sacred geometry. Designed as a spiritual vortex, Sri Puram is not just a place to visit—it is an experience to absorb. Here, silence hums with energy, the scent of incense mingles with tropical blooms, and the golden glow seems to breathe, inviting you to surrender into stillness.

At the heart of this celestial space, the shrine of Goddess Lakshmi, the embodiment of prosperity and spiritual abundance, welcomes seekers from all walks of life. Whether you come for prayer, contemplation, or simply to bask in the temple’s transcendent beauty, Sri Puram offers more than a moment of awe—it offers a deep, soul-stirring connection to something greater.

This retreat invites you to witness the magic of this sacred temple, to stand in its golden embrace, and to feel the pulse of ancient wisdom flowing through you. Are you ready to step into the divine?

settings.title: Day 5: MOUNT CANIGOU & CANALLETTE CAVES - June 23, 2025
settings.text:
• Overnight in Chateau Des Ducs de Joyeuse, Couiza France
  • Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner included
settings.dropdown_text:
This morning we will discover the deep mysticism of the ancient order of the early Benedictines when we visit the Abbey of St Michel de Cuxa, at the foot of the Holy Canigou Mountain in the Pyrénées. We will be able to visit a very special crypt, where an ancient Notre Dame de Sous Terra (Our Lady Beneath the Earth) sits. There are several items in this church that are rare and a must see for those on The Path. It was considered to be a place of pilgrimage.

Following lunch in the fortified town of Villefranche de Conflent, we will visit the stunning ‘Underground Versaille’, the Canallettes Caves, just outside of Villefranche de Conflent. Having the opportunity to enter a sacred cave gives us the opportunity to experience a connection with Gaia in a meaningful way.

settings.title: Day 6: COLLIOURE - June 24, 2025
settings.text:
• Overnight in Chateau Des Ducs de Joyeuse, Couiza France
  • Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner included
settings.dropdown_text:
A visit to Southern France will not be complete without seeing the azure-blue Mediterranean Sea. Therefore, today we will be driving to the most picturesque town of the entire Vermeille coast: Collioure. This ancient town already existed in the 6th century BCE as an important merchant harbour, famous for its arts and crafts, modern paintings and huge Templar Fortress.

You will have time this morning to visit the Chateau Royal if you wish, and then have free time to have lunch at a cafe by the Mediterranean Sea, explore this beautiful town and shop in the fun French boutiques.

settings.title: Day 7: PUILAURENS CASTLE - June 25, 2025
settings.text:
• Overnight in Chateau Des Ducs de Joyeuse, Couiza France
  • Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner included
settings.dropdown_text:
To dive into the origin of the Grail Quest we climb Puilaurens Castle in the morning. Built on the ruins of an old Roman Castrum, this castle is a perfect example of the strategic architecture that was also used at Montségur. The views from the top and from the early Gothic tower of *_Queen Blanche_*are breathtaking.

At Galamus we will visit a tiny hermit’s cave that has a wonderful surprise hidden inside. Not only is this an incredibly beautiful place, hanging on the edge of a cliff halfway up a gorge, its cave chapel also holds important messages if you have eyes to see them. This place is connected to the Franciscan monks who rebelled against the Roman Catholic Church’s persecution of the Cathars. In the 14th century, they were the last to hide scrolls that had been branded as heresy, but contained original texts and perhaps even the unedited original gospel of John and the original Lord’s Prayer. In honour of these brave Franciscan monks, Cameron will read and Elan will sing the Abwoon (original Lord’s Prayer in Aramaic) in the medieval Franciscan version, the oldest version known. In this special place of the Hermit and Monks we will take time to meditate, connecting with their unwavering faith and bravery.

settings.title: Day 8: VILLAGE OF RENNES LES BAINES IN CORBIERES - June 26, 2025
settings.text:
• Overnight in Chateau Des Ducs de Joyeuse, Couiza France
  • Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner included
settings.dropdown_text:
We will spend today in nature and not just in any random spot. We will visit an ancient outdoor Celtic Temple, a truly holy place. We’ll hike to the Isis Chair, an old carved seat near a holy well, where Celtic priestesses or the wise women of the woods meditated. These women were asked for advice on many occasions, even by kings. The ancient trail we walk is unchanged except for the natural erosion.

As we walk on this holy ground it will allow us to integrate all the lessons we’ve learned on this journey, empowered by the Earth energy currents beneath our feet. Balancing and cleansing our systems, we breathe in the land to be forever part of our bodies and minds, while we leave our footsteps behind in what the Jews, early Christians and Knights Templar called the New Holy Land. We are grateful for the opportunity to connect with our life questions as we ask the spirits of the Celtic Priestesses for clarity. Together we’ll have the final ceremony of our journey giving thanks for our Pilgrimage, for healing, for the spirits of the land & our ancestors, and for all that we’ve learned on our journey to Occitania.

settings.title: Day 9: CITÉ DE CARCASSONNE - June 27, 2025
settings.text:
• Overnight in Chateau Des Ducs de Joyeuse, Couiza France
  • Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner included
settings.dropdown_text:
Today we are traveling back 2000 years, while stepping forward into the present, to see the majestic medieval Cité de Carcassonne, where many movies have been shot. The Roman citadel Carcasso is still visible inside the medieval additions and repairs, forming stone layers like pages in a thick stone book. If only stones could speak…

This strategic fortified city with its 52 towers is the largest walled medieval city in Europe and is a World Heritage Site. We will browse through the stone book and discover the tales of brave knights, see the famous Siege Stone inside the Basilica St. Nazaire, discover hidden clues in glass windows and enjoy picture postcard views from the Porte d’Aude. There is also time for shopping to pick up a souvenir of this unique historical site.

settings.title: Day 11: PRIVATE BOAT TO THE SUN ISLAND. VISIT THE SACRED SITES - JUNE 3, 2025
settings.text: OVERNIGHT IN LA PAZ HOTEL RENNOVA
settings.dropdown_text: The Island of the Sun (Isla del Sol, or in Aymara, Titi'kaka) is a sacred island in Lake Titikaka surrounded by mystery and legend that has been a pilgrimage site for centuries or even millennia. On the island is a large rock outcrop known as Titi Qala (also sometimes referred to as the sacred stone, Roca Sagrada). According to various Incan legends, this was the birthplace of the Sun and/or the place where the Sun took refuge during a great flood in extremely ancient times, and from Titi Qala the Sun subsequently emerged again to shine on the new world after the disaster. What could the meaning of this legend be? Could it refer to the catastrophes and floods at the end of the last ice age? These are issues that Dr. Schoch will discuss. In another legend, the founder of the Incans, Manco Cápac (circa early 13th century) is said to have originated from the Island of the Sun. In terms of modern archaeology, there is evidence of the island having been occupied for over 4,000 years.

settings.title: Day 12: TIWANAKU - KALASASAYA TEMPLE AND PUMA PUKU - JUNE 4, 2025
settings.text:
• BUS RIDE TO LA PAZ CITY
  • OVERNIGHT IN LA PAZ HOTEL RENNOVA
settings.dropdown_text:
Tiwanaku (Tiahuanaco), in modern Bolivia, was the capital of a powerful pre-Hispanic empire that dominated a large area of the southern Andes and beyond. According to the standard story, it reached its apogee between 500 and 900 CE but had its origins much earlier (dating back to 200 BCE or before). We will explore the possibility that the site of Tiwanaku extends considerably further back in time, and possibly traces its origins to the end of the last ice age, over 12,000 years ago. At Tiwanaku  is found the Kalasasaya (Kalassasaya) complex with giant monolithic stone statues that many people have remarked remind them of the stone moai found on Easter Island. Stone heads dot the walls surrounding the main courtyard. A prominent feature, known around the world, is the Sun Gate with its intricate carvings, the potential significance of which Dr. Schoch will discuss. 

Associated with Tiwanaku is the renowned site of Puma Punku, known for its ancient “H-shaped” sculpted blocks that appear to have been machined. This site has attracted much attention because it appears to be so anomalous, so out of place and time. It remains one of the true technological enigmas of the ancient world. As we explore the site, we will question how Puma Puku was constructed, what purpose it served, how far back in time it goes, and how and when it might have been destroyed.

settings.title: Day 13: VISIT CARAL PYRAMID - JUNE 5, 2025
settings.text:
• FLY FROM LA PAZ TO LIMA DRIVE TO THE CARAL PYRAMID
  • OVERNIGHT IN LIMA MIRAFLORES -  WYNDHAM HOTEL DAZZLER
settings.dropdown_text: Caral is a huge archaeological complex, covering over 150 acres, that dates back nearly 5000 years. It was contemporaneous with the ancient Egyptians, and due to its pyramid structures, reminds many people of Egypt. Pyramids are found around the world in ancient times – is this just coincidence and convergence, as most mainstream archaeologists assert, or were ancient peoples in contact with each other long before the time of Columbus? These are issues we can discuss as we tour the pyramids and other incredible structures of Caral.

settings.dropdown_text: The Miguel Mujica Gallo Gold Museum, also known as the Gold Museum of Peru, contains approximately 7,000 supposed artifacts of pre-Columbian Peru, many of gold and other precious metals, as well as a collection of weapons from around the world. However, the museum has been mired in controversy as the authenticity of many of the artifacts has been questioned – are they real or are they modern fakes? Even if fakes, the collections of the museum provide the viewer with a striking representation and appreciation of the wealth and artistry of ancient Peruvian peoples. In examining the collection, one readily understands the Spanish conquistadors’ lust for the gold of the Incas.

settings.subtitle: MEET YOUR GUIDES
settings.title: Dr. Kulreet Chaudhary
settings.text:
Dr. Kulreet Chaudhary is a pioneering neurologist, neuroscientist, and Ayurvedic practitioner, recognized globally for her innovative approach to integrating cutting-edge modern medicine with the time-honored wisdom of Ayurveda. With a passion for holistic healing, Dr. Chaudhary has redefined the treatment paradigm for chronic disorders, emphasizing the mind-body connection and the role of ancient practices in modern health care.

A graduate of Loma Linda University, School of Medicine, she completed her internship at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), and her residency in neurology at the University of California, San Diego (UCSD). She also served as the Director of Neurology at Wellspring Health at Scripps Memorial Hospital. Dr. Chaudhary’s professional journey took a transformative turn when she began incorporating Ayurvedic principles into her practice, inspired by their profound impact on her patients’ well-being.

She authored two acclaimed books: The Prime, which explores the connection between gut health and brain function, and Sound Medicine, a compelling examination of sound therapy for emotional and physical healing. As part of the Healthy Directions family, she’s developing an at-home wellness program to help millions lead healthier, happier lives.

A sought-after speaker, Dr. Chaudhary has repeatedly shared her insights on national platforms, like The Dr. Oz Show and Home & Family, advocating for personalized medicine that addresses the root causes of disease. Through her work, she continues to inspire a global audience to embrace integrative medicine for optimal health and vitality.

settings.title: Joshua Barr
settings.text:
Joshua Barr is a modern-day yogi and master of sound healing, weaving ancient wisdom with a heart-centered approach to ignite profound transformation. With over 20 years of experience, Joshua has cultivated a unique alchemy of bodywork, sound healing, Varma therapy, Ayurveda, yoga, meditation, and Reiki to restore balance to the mind, body, and spirit. His journey began with a life-altering challenge—at just 25, a debilitating stroke left the left side of his body paralyzed. Despite a grim prognosis, Joshua defied the odds, harnessing the power of alternative healing to not only recover but to awaken a deeper calling within.

Joshua’s odyssey led him to Buddhist monasteries in Thailand and Cambodia, Hindu ashrams in India, and the revered Siddha masters of South India. For nearly a decade, he lived under the guidance of his Guru, Sri Sakthi Amma, in Tamil Nadu, learning the ancient art of sound healing as a tool for spiritual and physical renewal. This sacred knowledge, combined with his training as a licensed massage therapist, Yoga Alliance-certified instructor, Ayurvedic practitioner, and Reiki master, allows Joshua to offer an unparalleled depth of healing.

As a Nada Yogi, Joshua channels the vibrational power of sound to dissolve energetic blockages and awaken the innate healing potential within each individual. His compassionate presence and profound mastery of ancient techniques have touched countless lives, making him a beacon of transformation and a guide to rediscovering wholeness in an ever-fractured world.

settings.title: What happens during our retreat?
settings.text: Our retreats are immersive experiences designed to help you step away from daily distractions and reconnect with yourself. Each retreat includes: Daily meditation, breathwork, and mantra practices to calm the mind and enhance clarity. Sound healing sessions with Joshua Barr to balance your energy and promote deep relaxation. Ayurvedic therapies tailored to your body’s unique needs for physical and emotional well-being. Wisdom teachings from Siddha traditions to unlock new perspectives and personal growth. Neuro-transformation practices to help rewire limiting beliefs and create lasting change. A supportive community of like-minded individuals sharing this journey with you. No matter where you are in your transformation, our retreats provide the space, support, and tools to help you break free from old patterns and step into a more balanced, empowered version of yourself.

settings.title: What's the difference between Double and Single?
settings.text: Single occupancy means you will have your own room for all accommodations during the trip. Double occupancy means you will share a room with someone you plan to share the room with. Double occupancy rooms have two options: a shared bed or a room with two separate beds.

settings.title: Do I need to have a vaccine to travel to Peru and Bolivia?
settings.text:
You may need a yellow fever vaccine to enter Bolivia, depending on your country of origin.

For more information, visit: Passport Health: Yellow Fever Vaccinations.

Stay updated on current travel requirements, as they may change due to evolving public health conditions.

settings.title: Do you cater for Vegetarians or Vegans?
settings.text: Peru is known for its cuisine and excellent restaurants enjoyed by foodies. The restaurants we will visit will serve a variety of Peruvian, Bolivian and Western dishes with plenty of vegetarian options and some vegan options.

settings.title: What service can I expect when traveling with Jorge Delgado owner and founder of Kontiki Peru Tours.
settings.text: For 30 years Jorge Luis Delgado’s award-winning tour company Kontiki Tours has been leading people on memorable Andean journeys. You can expect a professional team with a high level of experience in the field of tourism and touring.  “We treat our clients with dedication and do our best for them to have unique and memorable experiences in our country. With Kontiki Tours you will have security, confidence and personalized attention, with guarantees that you, our clients deserve. We base our services in Munay, Llancay and Yachay (service, love and wisdom) as our ancient fathers based their lives.

settings.title: What happens during our retreat?
settings.text:
Our retreats are immersive experiences designed to help you step away from daily distractions and reconnect with yourself. Each retreat includes:
✔ Daily meditation, breathwork, and mantra practices to calm the mind and enhance clarity.
✔ Sound healing sessions with Joshua Barr to balance your energy and promote deep relaxation.
✔ Ayurvedic therapies tailored to your body’s unique needs for physical and emotional well-being.
✔ Wisdom teachings from Siddha traditions to unlock new perspectives and personal growth.
✔ Neuro-transformation practices to help rewire limiting beliefs and create lasting change.
✔ A supportive community of like-minded individuals sharing this journey with you.
No matter where you are in your transformation, our retreats provide the space, support, and tools to help you break free from old patterns and step into a more balanced, empowered version of yourself.

settings.title: Who is the retreat for?
settings.text: Anyone seeking deeper immersion in ancient wisdom, sacred rituals, holistic healing, and profound meditative experiences.

settings.title: What should I expect:
settings.text:
A powerful spiritual and wellness journey in the heart of India.

Experiences include:

  • Temple visits
  • Sacred ceremonies
  • Optional Ayurvedic & Siddha healing practices
  • Mantra meditation
  • Wisdom circles
  • Optional personalized consultations

settings.title: What are the core benefits of attending this retreat?
settings.text:
Participants leave our retreats feeling renewed, empowered, and deeply connected to their purpose.

Key benefits include:

✔ Breaking free from limiting beliefs that hold you back personally and professionally.
✔ Restoring balance in mind and body through Ayurveda, sound healing, and meditation.
✔ Experiencing profound emotional and physical renewal in a nurturing, immersive environment.
✔ Developing a stronger sense of self-awareness, clarity, and resilience.
✔ Learning practical tools to integrate wellness and transformation into daily life.
✔ Connecting with a like-minded community for continued support and inspiration.

This is more than a retreat—it’s a new way of being.

settings.title: Can I book a 1-on-1 consultation with Dr. Chaudhary before or after the retreat?
settings.text:
Yes! For those who want to deepen their transformation, Dr. Chaudhary offers:

🔹 Pre-Retreat Consultation: A personalized session to help you prepare your body and mind for the experience, including Ayurvedic guidance, herbal recommendations, and dosha balancing.

🔹 Post-Retreat Consultation: A follow-up to help you integrate the retreat’s insights into your daily life, ensuring long-term wellness and transformation.

Consultations are optional and available exclusively to retreat participants. They can be booked individually or as a package (both pre- and post-retreat sessions).

settings.title: What should I expect after the retreat?
settings.text:
The transformation doesn’t stop when the retreat ends. We provide:

Post-retreat integration resources to help you sustain your growth.

Optional 1-on-1 consultations with Dr. Chaudhary for ongoing Ayurvedic guidance.

A supportive community where you can stay connected with fellow participants.

Wisdom Hub content & courses to continue deepening your learning at home.

Many participants find that the shifts they experience during the retreat continue to unfold and expand in the months that follow, providing long-term benefits in health, mindset, and personal fulfillment.

settings.title: Do I need prior experience with Ayurveda, meditation, or sound healing to attend?
settings.text: Not at all! These retreats are open to everyone, from beginners to experienced practitioners. Our expert teachers will guide you step-by-step so you feel comfortable and supported in every practice. Whether you’re new to holistic wellness or already on a transformational journey, you will gain insights, healing, and practical tools that meet you where you are.

settings.title: What should I pack for the retreat?
settings.text:
A full packing list will be provided after registration, but here are a few essentials:

✔ Comfortable, modest, breathable clothing for yoga, meditation, and movement.
✔ Journal & pen for reflection and personal insights.
✔ Any personal Ayurvedic supplements or wellness items you use regularly.
✔ A shawl or light layers for temple visits and cooler evenings.
✔ Comfortable walking shoes for mindful walking sessions and temple visits.
For the India Retreat: You will receive specific cultural guidelines to help you prepare for a respectful and enriching experience.

settings.title: What are the recommended airports for the retreats?
settings.text: You can arrive either in Chennai or Bangalore (aka Bengaluru). Chennai is slightly closer, but both are good options. We will proivde you with recommendations for transportation to the Sri Narayani Holistic Centre.

settings.title: Insurance
settings.dropdown_text: We really highly seriously  recommend that all participants obtain travel insurance. Travel Insured International ( and other travel insurance companies) offers insurance for trip cost, trip cancellation & interruption, and pays for loss due to unforeseen circumstance, death, injury, or illness to you or a member of your family. It also includes coverage for missed connections due to weather, and pays for lost deposits due to the financial default of the airline, the tour operator, or cruise line. It pays for baggage delays, travel delays, medical expenses and emergency assistance.
